userFacingDescription: Firefox actively blocks trackers and protects users from being followed across the web to collect their browsing habits and interests, but these protections are mainly invisible during normal browsing. While users can view tracker blocking activity through the Privacy Panel (the shield icon in the browser chrome), many users are unaware that the Privacy Panel exists or do not actively seek it out. So we want to make Firefox's existing tracker blocking activity more visible at the moment it occurs and drawing users' attention to the Privacy Panel. We expect to increase awareness of Firefox's privacy value and strengthen users' perception that Firefox is a privacy focused browser.
userFacingName: Show Blocked Trackers After Page Loads
